summary: Sign-in is hardened across the Newsroom: staff must use Cloudron single sign-on, sign-in and signup forms are rate limited, session cookies are secure by default, and Admin API tokens can only be issued and revoked on the server.
detailed_changes: Staff and Cloudron accounts can now sign in only through Cloudron single sign-on; magic links, passwords and password resets are refused for them (#276).
Staff SSO accounts are linked by stable identity, with email matching only for verified addresses, and signed-in sessions are revoked when an account is linked or its role changes (#277).
Cloudron sign-in now uses PKCE and a nonce, and fully validates the ID token issuer, audience, expiry and signature (#278).
Magic-link, registration, password-reset, mailing-signup and SSO callback requests are rate limited, with a friendly retry message on forms (#279).
Session cookies are marked secure in production and responses send HSTS; API responses now carry the same security headers (#280).
Demo user seeding is restricted to local and testing environments, and deploy preflight warns if demo accounts exist (#281).
Removed the Admin API endpoint for creating tokens; tokens are issued, listed and revoked with server commands, and are revoked automatically when a user is demoted below Staff (#282).
Security reports now go through GitHub private vulnerability reporting; see SECURITY.md (#283).
affected_areas: Page or route: /login, /register, /forgot-password, magic links, /auth/cloudron callback, mailing and newsletter signup, /api/admin/v1
User groups affected: staff and admins (SSO only); public members (rate-limited forms)
Public impact: public sign-in is unchanged apart from rate limits on repeated attempts
Internal impact: staff must use the SSO button; Admin API tokens are managed with artisan on the server
